items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I wanted to mention one thing though, looking at your book recently . . . Ted Gioia, he really puts that music down.

ctx.x: Then you apparently got a contract with Capitol because then in March and May you guys did the famous Capitol sessions. Shall we talk about those?
Okay. I wanted to mention one thing though, looking at your book recently . . . Ted Gioia, he really puts that music down.
Really? I didn’t get that feeling.
